contexts.title: Public Transit
contexts.definition: Scheduled public transportation as GTFS describes it: the agencies that run it, the stops and routes they serve, the trips they schedule, the stop-by-stop times of those trips, and the live positions of the vehicles running them.

contexts.title: Shared Mobility
contexts.definition: Rentable shared vehicles such as dockless bikes, e-bikes and scooters as GBFS feeds publish them: where each available vehicle is, what kind it is, and how far it can go.

contexts.title: Street Network
contexts.definition: The physical road and street system and what sits on it: linear-referenced road segments with traffic volumes, traffic count stations, bridges, bikeways, metered curb parking and electric-vehicle charging sites.

contexts.title: Traffic Safety
contexts.definition: Police-reported motor-vehicle collisions described with the crash-level data elements of the MMUCC guideline: when and where they happened, how severe they were, and the road and environmental conditions.

concepts.definition: An organization or brand that runs scheduled public transportation service, identified within a GTFS feed by an agency id and named on its routes; one feed can carry several of them.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GTFS Schedule agency.txt; present in the CTtransit, Amtrak, Metro-North and Hartford Line feeds (email only in Hartford Line).

concepts.definition: A place where passengers board or leave scheduled public transport vehicles, such as a bus pole, a rail platform or a whole station grouping platforms, with its coordinates, public code and accessibility.

fields.name: stopCode
fields.description: Short public code shown to riders

fields.name: locationType
fields.description: GTFS location_type: 0 stop/platform, 1 station, 2 entrance/exit, 3 generic node, 4 boarding area

fields.name: parentStation
fields.description: stopId of the station this stop belongs to

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GTFS Schedule stops.txt; fields shared by the CTtransit, Amtrak, Metro-North and Hartford Line feeds; GTFS-realtime stop_id references them.

concepts.definition: A named or numbered public transport service that riders recognize, such as bus route 212 or the Shore Line East commuter rail, grouping the scheduled trips one agency runs under that name.

fields.name: agencyId
fields.description: agency_id of the Transit Agency that runs it

fields.name: routeType
fields.description: GTFS route_type: 0 tram, 1 subway, 2 rail, 3 bus, 4 ferry, 5 cable tram, 6 aerial lift, 7 funicular, 11 trolleybus, 12 monorail

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GTFS Schedule routes.txt, present in all four Connecticut feeds; GTFS-realtime TripDescriptor.route_id references it.

concepts.definition: One scheduled run of a public transport vehicle along a route, from its first stop to its last, on the service days its calendar names; realtime feeds point at it to report delays and positions.

fields.name: serviceId
fields.description: Service calendar the trip runs on

fields.name: blockId
fields.description: Vehicle block the trip belongs to

fields.name: startTime
fields.description: Scheduled start HH:MM:SS of one run (realtime)

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GTFS Schedule trips.txt (all four CT feeds) plus GTFS-realtime TripDescriptor (trip_id, route_id, direction_id, start_date, start_time).

concepts.definition: One scheduled visit of a trip to a stop: the planned arrival and departure, the order of the visit along the trip, boarding rules, and, from realtime feeds, the predicted time and delay.

fields.name: arrivalTime
fields.description: Scheduled HH:MM:SS on the service day; may pass 24:00:00

fields.name: departureTime
fields.description: Scheduled HH:MM:SS on the service day; may pass 24:00:00

fields.name: pickupType
fields.description: GTFS 0 regular, 1 none, 2 phone, 3 ask driver

fields.name: dropOffType
fields.description: GTFS 0 regular, 1 none, 2 phone, 3 ask driver

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GTFS Schedule stop_times.txt (all four CT feeds) plus GTFS-realtime TripUpdate.StopTimeUpdate / StopTimeEvent (CTtransit TripUpdates feed).

concepts.definition: A timestamped report of where an in-service transit vehicle is, which trip it is running, how fast and which way it is heading, and how close it is to its next stop.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GTFS-realtime VehiclePosition, Position, VehicleDescriptor and TripDescriptor messages; every field confirmed in the live CTtransit VehiclePositions.json feed (2026-10-13).

concepts.definition: A bike, e-bike or scooter that a mobility operator offers for short public rental, reported with its current location, availability, vehicle type and remaining range; dockless ones are parked anywhere.

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Operator id; GBFS requires it to rotate after each trip

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: GBFS vehicle_status (v3) / free_bike_status (v2.2) plus vehicle_types; confirmed against the live Veo New Haven GBFS 2.2 feed.

concepts.definition: A stretch of public road identified by a linear-referencing route id and a begin and end milepoint, carrying the street name, town and, where counted, its annual average daily traffic.

fields.name: routeId
fields.description: State LRS route id (CTDOT: town number + local road number for local roads)

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: CTDOT Roadway Basemap local roads (ROUTE_ID, BEGIN/END_POINT, TOWN_NUMBER, TOWN_NAME, STREET_NAME) and CTDOT AADT segments (same ROUTE_ID and milepoints plus AADT value, year and station).

concepts.definition: A fixed roadside location where a transportation agency periodically counts vehicles, located by route and milepoint, whose counts produce the annual average daily traffic of nearby road segments.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: CTDOT Traffic Count Locations layer; StationID is the key the AADT segments layer cites as AADT_STATION_ID.

concepts.definition: A structure longer than 20 feet carrying a road, railway or path over a waterway, road or other obstacle, inventoried by its structure number with year built, traffic carried, and inspected deck, superstructure, substructure and culvert condition ratings.

fields.name: highwaySystem
fields.description: On the National Highway System (NBI item 104)

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: FHWA National Bridge Inventory items (Recording and Coding Guide); every field is an NBI item that the CTDOT Bridges layer also carries by item number.

concepts.definition: A street or path segment designated for cycling, from a signed shared route to a protected lane or off-road trail, with its facility type, whether it exists or is only planned, and how comfortable it is to ride.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: City of New Haven Bike Routes layer (roadnames, descript, status, rating, description); a single source so far.

concepts.definition: One marked place to park a vehicle, such as a metered on-street curb space, with its meter and post numbers, block-face zone, pay-by-phone zone, posted rate and coordinates.

fields.name: rateSpec
fields.description: Time limit and hourly rate code, e.g. NTL/$1.50

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: City of New Haven Metered Parking Spaces layer (facilityid, meternum, spacenum, post_num, promid, zone_, meterspec, lz, pm_lat/pm_long).

concepts.definition: A site where electric vehicles can plug in to recharge, with its owner, public or private access, fee terms, counts of Level 2 and DC fast ports, and connector type.

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: City of New Haven EV charging inventory; port counts, connector, access and open date are also the core of the US DOE AFDC station record (ev_level2_evse_num, ev_dc_fast_num, ev_connector_types, access_code, open_date).

concepts.definition: A police-reported collision involving at least one motor vehicle in transport on a trafficway, recorded with its date, place, severity, first harmful event, manner of collision and light, weather and road conditions.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Crash severity on the KABCO scale (fatal, injury, property damage only)

fields.name: mostSevereInjury
fields.description: KABCO code of the worst injury

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: MMUCC 6th edition crash-level elements (S1-S2, C1-C18) and the UConn Connecticut Crash Data Repository crash layer, whose attribute values follow MMUCC lists. Person and vehicle levels left out: they carry age, sex and injury of identifiable people.

sources.title: CTtransit GTFS schedule (statewide, incl. New Haven division)
sources.recordDescription: A GTFS Schedule feed: each stops.txt row is one bus stop, routes.txt one route, trips.txt one scheduled trip and stop_times.txt one scheduled stop visit.
sources.license: CTtransit GTFS Data Terms of Use (free use with attribution)
sources.note: One zip covers Hartford, New Haven (agency_id 2), Stamford, New Britain, Waterbury-Meriden and CTfastrak. Fields read from the feed files downloaded 2026-10-13; no feed_info.txt.

sources.title: Amtrak GTFS (includes Shore Line East)
sources.recordDescription: A GTFS Schedule feed for Amtrak intercity, Thruway and Shore Line East service; each stops.txt row is one station keyed by its Amtrak code.
sources.note: The official Shore Line East feed (agency_id 1230). Station ids (NHV, STS) differ from Metro-North and Hartford Line ids: cross-feed stations join by coordinates or name.

sources.title: MTA Metro-North Railroad GTFS (New Haven Line)
sources.recordDescription: A GTFS Schedule feed for Metro-North; each stops.txt row is one station (New Haven Union Station is stop_id 149).

sources.title: CTtransit GTFS-realtime (vehicle positions, trip updates, alerts)
sources.recordDescription: One GTFS-realtime FeedEntity: a live bus position, or one trip's predicted stop-time updates.
sources.license: CTtransit GTFS Data Terms of Use (free use with attribution)
sources.note: No key. Field names are paths in the JSON rendering (replace .pb with .json); trip updates at TripUpdate/TripUpdates.pb, alerts at Alert/Alerts.pb. Statewide: filter route_id by agency 2 for New Haven.

sources.title: Veo New Haven micromobility GBFS feed
sources.recordDescription: One free_bike_status row is one currently available dockless e-bike or scooter with its position, vehicle type and range.
sources.note: GBFS 2.2, no key; dockless, so no station_information. bike_id rotates. Listed in MobilityData systems.csv as veo-nhv.

sources.title: CTDOT Roadway Basemap: Local Roads
sources.recordDescription: One local-road LRS route segment (polyline) with its CTDOT route id, milepoints, town and street name.
sources.license: CTDOT open data disclaimer (informational use; no formal open license stated)
sources.note: TOWN_NUMBER is CTDOT's own town numbering (New Haven 092), not the OPM tax code (93).

sources.title: CTDOT Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) segments
sources.recordDescription: One road segment (route id and milepoint range) with its latest AADT value and the count station it came from.
sources.license: CTDOT open data disclaimer (informational use; no formal open license stated)

sources.title: CTDOT Traffic Count Locations
sources.recordDescription: One traffic count station (point) on a state route or local road, with a link to its hourly count history.
sources.license: CTDOT open data disclaimer (informational use; no formal open license stated)
sources.note: TownNumber is empty in practice; the CTDOT town number appears in the StationID prefix and in HourlyCountLink (town=92 for New Haven).

sources.title: CTDOT Bridges (National Bridge Inventory)
sources.recordDescription: One bridge or culvert over 20 ft (polygon) with its NBI inventory items and condition ratings.
sources.license: CTDOT open data disclaimer (informational use; no formal open license stated)
sources.note: Fields are NBI items named by item number, with coded ratings given as 'code - description' and lengths in feet (NBI submits metres).

sources.title: Connecticut Crash Data Repository: crashes (2015 to present)
sources.recordDescription: One police-reported motor-vehicle crash (point) with MMUCC crash-level attributes.
sources.license: CTDOT/UConn disclaimer (informational use; subject to 23 USC 407)
sources.note: Crash-level values checked against MMUCC attribute lists (type of intersection, light condition, manner of collision, school-bus-related, relation to junction). Person (layer 1) and Vehicle (layer 2) layers not listed here.

sources.title: New Haven Metered Parking Spaces
sources.publisher: City of New Haven, Transportation, Traffic and Parking
sources.recordDescription: One metered on-street parking space with meter id, rate code and meter zone.

sources.title: New Haven Bike Routes
sources.recordDescription: One bikeway segment with road name, facility type, existing or proposed status and a 1-4 comfort rating.

sources.title: New Haven EV Charging Stations (city inventory)
sources.recordDescription: One EV charging site with owner, access and fee terms and counts of Level 2 and DC fast ports.
sources.note: 24 rows, last edited 2023; the US DOE AFDC station locator is more complete.
